nodes.label: Conduct Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Maintainers clarify and enforce acceptable behavior to sustain a harassment-free project.

nodes.label: Contribution Validation Checklist
nodes.rationale: Focused changes, relevant checks, updated documentation, and secret-free diffs make pull requests reviewable and safe.

nodes.label: Security Response Process
nodes.rationale: Maintainers acknowledge, triage, assess, fix, validate, and communicate security resolutions.

nodes.label: Evaluation First
nodes.rationale: Define baselines, metrics, failure sets, and acceptance thresholds before changing a model or prompt.

nodes.label: Typed Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Validate LLM, tool, and API payloads before they change application state.

nodes.label: Observability
nodes.rationale: Record traces, token use, retries, routing decisions, and failure reasons.

nodes.label: Security
nodes.rationale: Scope credentials, validate inputs, isolate tool execution, and define retention limits.

nodes.label: Confidentiality Boundary
nodes.rationale: Employer-internal measurements are separated from public related implementations; client names, source data, task definitions, prompts, schemas, and proprietary code are omitted.
